description: Reviewed outcome for every value selected from an external (URL) source and for every pending field whose open question is an external technical source (review of 2026-11-11; the three aramcoULTRA 8 fields reviewed as pending alternatives were selected on 2026-11-11 and are external_selected cases now). One entry per product x property. 'expect' pins the record as reviewed; external_review.py stops if the record has changed. Outcomes: confirmed = the value was re-read as printed on a copy that was obtained; inconclusive_source_unavailable = no copy of the source could be obtained, so the value was not re-read. External evidence is admissible (the templates define source.file as an archive file or a URL in source_registry.json); there is no blanket rule for or against it. Each source is assessed separately on authority, authenticity and provenance (per evidence item) and each case on exact product identity and applicability (per case). 'confirmed' states only that the value is printed as recorded: it is not an approval to select the source, and a distributor-issued document is never treated as manufacturer-issued. identity_status concerns only the link between this source and this record; a question about merging two records (ID-01) is recorded apart from it. Nothing in this file changes product data.

observations.text: The byte-verified Aramco sheet prints 'Noack Volatility (Procedure B) | wt% | D 5800 | 7.5'; the record's DL2-12172.pdf prints a maximum of 7. A typical above the specification maximum is logically incompatible: recorded as conflict EVR-2026-11-11-230-noack (not resolved; the selected value is unchanged).

The Aramco sheet prints 'Density @ 15 °C | kg/L | D 4052 | 0.8635', a third value beside DL2-12172.pdf (0.8630, no unit) and DL2-11773.pdf (0.8625, provisional). Recorded as conflict EVR-2026-11-11-230-density-external; the field stays pending.

The MOGO flyer prints 'Sp. Gravity, 15/4 °C | ASTM D 4052 | 0.834' for BAPbase 4. Not filled: the flyer is distributor-issued (Ergon/MOGO), not a Bapco document, and a distributor description is not accepted automatically; its authority for this grade has not been assessed further.
